_note: Single source of truth for cloned-voice params. Used by chatterbox_tts.py (game render) and the AGM speak endpoint. exaggeration=emotion intensity (0.3 calm .. 0.9 hot); cfg_weight=pacing/adherence (lower=slower/more deliberate). Refs relative to server/tts/. pbp=Breen (podcast clip), color=Clyde (blended Rhyme-Time + FOX5 interview). hypeBoost adds to pbp exaggeration on big calls (BANG/dunks/buzzer-beaters) — see chatterbox_tts.py.
